name: Khatron Ke Khiladi
description: Twelve celebrity contestants face their worst fears and perform a series of death-defying stunts under the supervision of a host to win the coveted title.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Indian version of Fear Factor.

videos.title: Tasting earthwoms
videos.overview: The season starts with the introduction of the thirteen contestants and their partners. Akshay Kumar leads them to the first two stunts, 'Toofani Tube' and 'Keede Padenge'. Shweta gets her first safety band.

videos.title: Wins and loss for the team blue
Tug of war like never before!
Lopamudra, the weakest of them all?
Golmaal Again cast witness the finale
Creepy crawlers, Unlimited pranks
videos.overview: Prepare for the biggest and most thrilling show in the history of Indian television as Rohit Shetty takes your favourite stars on a prank-filled battle over fear. Bugs crawl on skin and knees shake uncontrollably as Sree Santh, Bharti Singh and Avika Gor take on not one or two, but five insects at the same time. And this is just Day one.

videos.title: The Grand Premiere!
videos.overview: Watch the daredevil celebrity contestants perform deadly stunts as Rohit Shetty returns with a new and thrilling season of Khatron Ke Khiladi!

videos.title: Dekho, sher aaya!
videos.overview: Rohit Shetty throws a curveball at the Khiladis! Can they face the mighty lion?

videos.title: Ultimate hilarity with Haarsh!
videos.overview: The contestants are in for a fun time as Rohit Shetty introduces the popular ex-contestant Haarsh Limbachiyaa as the official Stunt Tester for the show. Later, Balraj Syal, RJ Malishka and Rani Chatterjee are in the spotlight when they face the heat of the first elimination stunt of the season, owing to their low scores. Which contestant's journey will see the end? Watch this entertainment-packed episode to find out.

videos.title: A new twister for the contestants!
videos.overview: They've always fought to save themselves, however, this time, Rohit Shetty brings a shocker like never before, the contestants have to finish the task in time to save their phones from getting destroyed in the mixer. Watch this psychologically gruelling task to see if your favourite contestants manage to save their phones as well as themselves from the eliminations.

videos.title: The hellish rain of wax!
videos.overview: An air of terror surrounds the contestants as Rohit Shetty introduces the gruelling elimination task that awaits Tejasswi Prakash, Balraj Syal, and Amruta Khanvilkar. Who will have their journey cut short as they face a hellish rain of hot molten wax and fire? Also, watch as Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa bring a wave of laughter with them in this episode filled with screams and laughter.

videos.title: Shivin's day of terror!
videos.overview: Shivin Narang, the chocolate boy of the silver screen, faces backlash when he aborts the first stunt of the day. Furthermore, the tear gas from his second stunt lands him in the emergency room for medical assistance, thus making him incapable of performing the elimination stunt. With the given situation, he is bound to request the contestants for a proxy, but will they oblige to his request? Watch this entertainment-packed episode to find out.

videos.title: Team Week: Team Tejasswi vs Team Karan!
videos.overview: Karan Patel and Tejasswi Prakash are chosen as the captains with the announcement of the Team Week. While Balraj Syal returns to the game with high spirits, watch your favourite contestants as they face their worst fears, heights, electricity, water and creepy crawlies. Whose team will face the dreaded Elimination stunt - Tejasswi or Karan? Watch the exciting episode to find out.

videos.title: Karishma ki kashmakash!
videos.overview: With the Team Week on, Karan Patel's team has managed to secure thirty points and stay ahead of Team Tejasswi, who haven't managed to score any points yet. Karishma Tanna, a member of Team Tejasswi is allowed to switch teams owing to her team's weak performance as well as an imbalance in the number of contestants. Will Karishma ditch Team Tejasswi and join the rival team? Watch this intriguing episode to find out.

videos.title: Kya Tejasswi mana payegi Mallishka ko?
videos.overview: Captain Tejasswi Prakash faces a dilemma of selecting two contestants to perform the elimination stunt. While she allows Karishma Tanna and Shivin Narang to skip this stunt owing to their spectacular performances during their previous stunts, she opts to perform the stunt with RJ Mallishka. However, Tejasswi now faces the uphill task of convincing Mallishka to perform the stunt with her. Can she convince Mallishka? Also, will this decision of hers save her from getting eliminated?

videos.title: An advantage over fear!
videos.overview: Despite having won the advantage task to gain an edge over her rival with some help from Balraj Syal, Amruta Khanvilkar fails to complete the main task as she aborts it. Will her failure turn disastrous for her? Or will she be able to make a comeback in the final task of the day, where she faces none other than Balraj? Watch the exciting episode.

videos.title: Sink and find the glint!
videos.overview: A blast from the past awaits the contestants this week as Rohit Shetty brings back the best stunts from the previous seasons, starting with the highly dangerous water rotor task! With time ticking and a partner to unlock, will the contestants survive this breathtaking ordeal? Tune in to this thrilling episode to find out.

videos.title: Jeepers creepers, Shivin gets the creepers!
videos.overview: Shivin Narang is struck with terror as he faces a plethora of creatures during the Treasure Hunting stunt. That's not all, as he must overcome his biggest challenge - the fear of rodents! With the danger of elimination closing in, will he gather the guts to overcome his biggest fear?

videos.title: Who Escapes The Elimination?
videos.overview: The Khiladis, after a long break, are geared up to get back in their strides and show their might. In today's episode, the bottom three contestants, Balraj Syal, Adaa Khan and Shivin Narang compete against each other in the most dangerous tasks to save themselves from elimination. Who among the three will secure their place to proceed further?

videos.title: Rohit And Karan Prank Balraj!
videos.overview: Rohit Shetty kicks off the Partner Week in this exciting episode where the contestants compete as pairs to qualify for the next rounds. Amidst the competition, Rohit and Karan Patel decide to prank Balraj Syal, who is blindfolded, by making him believe that he is jumping into the deep end of the pool. However, it is a baby pool Balraj is about to jump into! With Balraj hesitant and afraid of aquatic tasks, will he be able to take a leap of faith?

videos.title: The Human Torch!
videos.overview: Tension escalates among the Khiladis as Rohit Shetty demonstrates the latest stunt for the Partner Week. The Khiladis will have to torch themselves and burn the dummies placed at a distance before time runs out and put their life in imminent peril. Will the Khiladis dare to do the extreme?

videos.title: Race to the finale!
videos.overview: After overcoming the challenge of the Fear Fanda tasks, all the contestants move to the next level to win the ticket to the finale. In this task, the contestants will be left hanging from a moving truck and will have to figure out an escape route to make it to the safe zone. Who will step up to the task and earn a ticket to the finale?

videos.title: In pursuit of parking!
videos.overview: With the race to reach the finals on, the contestants gear up for their next stunt. However, the drive to win takes a new turn when their task requires them to move their car in the designated space before their car blows up! Who will be the next finalist to join Tejasswi Prakash in the ticket to the finale?

videos.title: Can Smriti change Shivin's luck?
videos.overview: Rohit Shetty initiates the Dosti Special week and invites the Khiladis' best friends to help them perform the next set of tasks. Shivin Narang's good buddy and supportive friend, Smriti Kalra, arrives on the show hoping to help Shivin get rid of his reputation of aborting the tasks. Will Smriti's motivation help Shivin during their performance and change his luck in the competition?

videos.title: Tejasswi looks for a proxy
videos.overview: It's the face-off before the big fight as the contenders get ready for the upcoming task that would decide who goes to the semi-finals. While the contestants brave chicken curry and rotten markets, Tejasswi Prakash is given a chance to send a substitute in her stead for the task. Will Tejasswi be able to convince one of the players to play for her?

videos.title: Can Karishma soar into the finale?
videos.overview: Rohit Shetty greets the four semi-finalists and congratulates them on reaching the final leg of the race. To motivate the Khiladis, Rohit reveals that one of them can secure a spot in the grand finale by emerging victorious in the next set of tasks. As the first stunt is initiated, Karan Patel faces off against Karishma Tanna and are tasked with collecting flags stuck to a car which is suspended very high up in the air. Who will win this pulsating contest?

videos.title: The extreme extravaganza!
videos.overview: Buckle up as Karishma Tanna, Karan Patel, Dharmesh Yelande, and Balraj Syal go against each other to secure their spot in the finale. And the two finalists will have to portray an exemplary skill set to win the final task and become the one to take home the coveted prize.

videos.title: Karan vs Karishma: The final showdown!
videos.overview: After outclassing Balraj Syal in the penultimate task, Karan Patel joins Dharmesh Yelande and Karishma Tanna in the final showdown. Determined to become the first female winner of Khatron Ke Khiladi, Karishma gives it her all. Will she succeed in becoming the ultimate Khiladi?

videos.title: Desi roller-coaster adventure kicks off!
videos.overview: Eight best handpicked Khiladis are about to skate on thin ice as the gates of Zulm city are open, and your favourite stunt reality show is back with a bang! A 100% Made in India season with high octane action and a new host, Farah Khan Kunder. She is all geared up for the desi roller-coaster ride.

videos.title: Torture, torment and terror!
videos.overview: Farah Khan Kunder introduces the first gruelling task in which the contestant's blood run cold as they need to enter a Jacuzzi full of unbearable dirt and waste! The torture goes up a notch as they face another horrifying task in which they are caged in a box filled with water. Will the contestants be able to endure the extreme heebie-jeebies?

videos.title: Get ready for a ride upside down!
An electrifying task for the teams
Mega Premiere: Darr Next Level
videos.overview: Rohit Shetty kick-starts the new season with a new twist! This time around, stunts are not the only challenges that contestants will face as Rohit has a 'Junglee' plan in mind!

videos.title: Code Red and a shock for Khiladis
videos.overview: Khiladis continue their jungle escapades with the wild life of Africa. Rohit Shetty introduces Code Red and leaves the contestants shocked!

videos.title: Daisy faces terror
videos.overview: The Khiladis are divided into partners to complete the tasks. Daisy Shah and Anjali Anand team up to face the deadly crocodile challenge, in which Daisy gets blindfolded. Which team will complete the mission successfully?

videos.title: The water puzzle!
videos.overview: Khiladis are back in Capetown! And while they celebrate, 'Code Redl welcomes them with a new twist. While some partners become rivals, some rivals prove themselves to be the best partners. In the end, an unexpected abort from a khiladi disappoints Rohit Shetty

videos.title: A battle on a moving truck!
videos.overview:
The Khiladis become ecstatic as Rohit Shetty announces that this week is an elimination-free week. Further, Dino James and Arjit Taneja compete in a tug-of-war stunt on a moving vehicle. Who will win

the challenge and advance to the finale?
